modelOverview: The Royal Oak Selfwinding 41mm (reference 15510, introduced in 2022 for AP's 50th anniversary as the refined successor to the 2019-launched 15500, which itself replaced the original 15400) is the definitive full-size automatic Royal Oak, pairing Gerald Genta's octagonal bezel and integrated bracelet with the in-house self-winding Calibre 4302. It is offered in stainless steel and precious metals, almost always with the signature 'Grande Tapisserie' waffle dial, making it the daily-wear cornerstone of the Royal Oak line. All examples are sourced and authenticated by our specialists before sale.

15510ST.OO.1320ST.06.materials: Stainless steel case and integrated bracelet
15510ST.OO.1320ST.06.bezel: Octagonal stainless steel bezel with polished bevels and eight signature hexagonal screws
15510ST.OO.1320ST.06.dial: Blue 'Grande Tapisserie' dial with white gold applied hour-markers and Royal Oak hands with luminescent coating
15510ST.OO.1320ST.06.description: The steel Royal Oak Selfwinding 41mm in blue is the reference against which every integrated-bracelet sports watch is measured, defined by its Genta octagonal bezel and 'Grande Tapisserie' waffle dial. The deep 'Bleu Nuit, Nuage 50' dial nods to the shade of the original 1972 Royal Oak while the Calibre 4302 delivers a ~70-hour power reserve visible through the sapphire caseback. Sourced and authenticated by our specialists.
